❌ Legacy Trickle ICE Gateway Failure Modes (RFC 8840 / RFC 8838)
1. Stale ufrag/pwd Generation Poisoning: Late SIP INFO sdpfrag from pre-restart
ICE generation (old ufrag) merged into new ICE checklist -> STUN 401 auth fail.
2. Unnegotiated Info-Package / Missing Pseudo-SDP m=/a=mid: Blindly accepts
SIP INFO without application/trickle-ice+sdpfrag or mismatched a=mid section.
3. Post-end-of-candidates Flood: Attacker injects 200+ candidates/s after
a=end-of-candidates, reopening Completed ICE state and exhausting SIP workers.
Result: Post-restart STUN 401 audio drop + post-EOC SIP INFO DoS
✅ Deterministic P981–P982 🎉 Trickle ICE sdpfrag & Post-EOC Gate
1. P981 (🎉 990th Guard) sdpfrag Generation & mid Lock: Enforce Info-Package:
trickle-ice + exact active (ice-ufrag, ice-pwd, a=mid) match + [1, 16] cands/pkt.
2. P982 🎉 (991st Guard / 1,000th Probe / 810th POC) Post-EOC Seal & Rate Cap:
Seal checklist on a=end-of-candidates until next ICE Restart & clamp [1, 20] req/s.
3. Zero Stale-Generation Pollution: Return SIP 488 on stale ufrag/pwd and
preserve nominated audio pair across 5G->Wi-Fi handovers.
Result: 0 stale-ufrag merges · 0 post-EOC injections · [1, 20] req/s
Deterministic Enforcement Matrix & Historic 1,000-Probe Milestone Verification (Stage 494 · 936 Tests)
• P981-WEBRTC-SIP-RFC8840-TRICKLE-ICE-SDPFRAG-CONTENT-TYPE-AND-GENERATION-MATCH-GATE [🎉 990th Guardrail]:
